title: Apple Ships HomeView Hub Nov 13 to Challenge AI Home Rivals
summary:
Access to personal data on a new smart-home display is tethered to a nearby unlocked iPhone despite the device's ability to recognize individual users. Known as HomeView, the hub ships Nov 13 and can identify up to six residents in one household to provide tailored settings. It integrates a personalized version of Siri to compete for market share against smart-home ecosystems from Amazon and Google.

Apple introduced the hardware at an event in New York as a central component of a strategy to narrow its AI gap with rivals. By requiring a mobile device for identity verification, the company aims to scale its home automation presence while reinforcing its reputation for strict user privacy.
